2.label: SIRD
2.description: High BMI, high triglycerides, low HDL — insulin resistance pattern
2.treatment_focus: Weight management, insulin sensitizers (metformin), cardiovascular monitoring

1.label: SIDD
1.description: High TG/HDL ratio — metabolic derangement pattern (proxy for insulin deficiency)
1.treatment_focus: Blood glucose monitoring, consider insulin therapy, monitor for complications

0.label: MOD
0.description: Elevated BMI with moderate metabolic markers — obesity-driven pattern
0.treatment_focus: Weight loss (5-10%), healthy eating, moderate exercise, lipid monitoring

3.label: MARD
3.description: Older age with mild metabolic values — age-related pattern
3.treatment_focus: Regular health checkups, lifestyle management, cardiovascular screening
